items: Recommends a primary programming language or tech stack with rationale
Proposes a database or storage solution appropriate to the data model
Addresses at least two non-functional requirements (performance, reliability, security, scalability)
Describes an API design approach (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, event-driven, etc.)
Proposes a deployment or hosting approach (cloud provider, containerization, serverless, etc.)
Identifies the primary architectural pattern (microservices, monolith, event-driven, etc.)
Mentions caching, CDN, or performance optimization strategy
Proposes monitoring, logging, or observability tooling
Addresses data security, encryption, or privacy requirements
